'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[2023 Ukrainian counteroffensive]]
***[[Armed forces of Ukraine|Ukrainian forces]] claim to have retaken three villages south of [[Velyka Novosilka]] in the southern [[Donetsk region]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/jun/11/ukraine-claims-to-have-liberated-two-frontline-villages-in-donetsk (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2023 Đắk Lắk shooting]]
**Four police officers are killed and two others are injured in shootings at two [[police station]]s in [[Cư Kuin district|Cư Kuin]], [[Đắk Lắk province|Đắk Lắk]], [[Vietnam]]. Sixteen people are arrested. [https://www.channelnewsasia.com/asia/several-killed-wounded-vietnam-central-highlands-police-station-attacks-3554261 (CNA)]
*Three people are killed and three others are injured after border clashes near the [[North Waziristan District]], [[Khyber Pakhtunkhwa]], [[Pakistan]], on the [[Afghanistan–Pakistan border barrier|Afghanistan–Pakistan border]]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Interstate 95 highway collapse]]
**A section of [[Interstate 95]] in [[Philadelphia]], [[Pennsylvania]], [[United States]], collapses after a [[tanker truck]] catches fire under an overpass. [https://www.cnn.com/2023/06/11/us/philadelphia-i-95-collapse-fire/index.html (CNN)]
*[[Greta bus crash]]
**Ten people are killed and 25 others are injured in a bus crash near [[Greta, New South Wales|Greta]], [[New South Wales]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/least-10-people-killed-bus-accident-australia-2023-06-11/ (Reuters)]
*Three British [[tourism in Egypt|tourists]] are killed and 26 other people are rescued after a boat fire in the [[Red Sea]] near [[Marsa Alam]], [[Egypt]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/three-british-tourists-dead-after-boat-fire-egypts-red-sea-2023-06-12/ (Reuters)]

'''International relations'''
*[[China–Honduras relations]]
**[[Honduras]] opens its first [[embassy]] in [[Beijing]], [[China]], after breaking off relations with [[Taiwan]] in March. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/world/honduras-opens-embassy-china-breaking-ties-taiwan-rcna88733 (NBC News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*Former [[Scottish First Minister]] [[Nicola Sturgeon]] is arrested as part of an investigation into financial misconduct by the [[Scottish National Party]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news/2023/jun/11/nicola-sturgeon-arrestedquestioned-in-snp-finances-inquiry (''The Guardian'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 FIA World Endurance Championship]]
**[[2023 24 Hours of Le Mans]]
***In [[endurance racing (motorsport)|endurance racing]], the [[AF Corse]] [[Ferrari]] team wins the [[2023 24 Hours of Le Mans|91st Le Mans 24 Hours]] with drivers [[James Calado]], [[Antonio Giovinazzi]] and [[Alessandro Pier Guidi]]. It is Ferrari's first victory at the event since 1965. [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2023/jun/11/24-hours-of-le-mans-ferrari-lebron-james (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2021–2023 ICC World Test Championship]]
**In [[Test cricket]], [[Australia national cricket team|Australia]] win their first [[ICC World Test Championship|Test World Cup]] title, defeating [[India national cricket team|India]] by 209 [[Run (cricket)|runs]] on the [[2023 ICC World Test Championship final|final]] day at [[The Oval]] in [[London]], [[England]]. Australia's [[Travis Head]] is named [[Player of the Match awards (cricket)|player of the match]]. [https://www.bbc.com/sport/cricket/65867740 (BBC Sport)]
*[[2023 French Open]]
**In [[tennis]], [[Novak Djokovic]] defeats [[Casper Ruud]] 7–6<sup>(7–1)</sup>, 6–3, 7–5 in the final to win the [[2023 French Open – Men's singles|men's singles]] title at the 2023 [[French Open]]. Djokovic surpasses the [[List of Grand Slam–related tennis records|record]] he shared with [[Rafael Nadal]] to become the men's singles player with the most [[Grand Slam (tennis)|Grand Slam]] titles (23). [https://www.theguardian.com/sport/2023/jun/11/novak-djokovic-casper-ruud-french-open-23-grand-slam-titles-tennis (''The Guardian'')]
*[[2023 FIFA U-20 World Cup]]
**In [[association football]], [[Uruguay national under-20 football team|Uruguay]] win their first [[FIFA U-20 World Cup]] title with a 1–0 victory over [[Italy national under-20 football team|Italy]] in the [[2023 FIFA U-20 World Cup final|final]] at the [[Estadio Único]] in [[La Plata]], [[Argentina]]. Italy's [[Cesare Casadei]] is awarded the tournament's [[FIFA U-20 World Cup#Awards|Golden Ball]]. [https://apnews.com/article/uruguay-italy-u20-world-cup-final-soccer-af8faf206db4ab2c03ef75194b306729 (AP)]
